description: Full public profile for one organization by slug: description, country, funding rounds (raised or led), people, any disclosure, editor_disclosure (current when the editor holds equity, past when it previously did, otherwise none), our published coverage of it (articles, newsletter issues, podcast episodes), and its products (company-provided, not part of the CC BY dataset), each with an agent_access object when API, sandbox, llms.txt, OpenAPI or MCP details are set. Also lei, licences[] (approved register entries, each with source_url and last_checked_at) and certifications[] (self-reported by the company, with evidence_url).
name: get_organization
title: Get a company or investor
